name: happy
description: Recorded live against api.elfa.ai on 2026-11-23 with deno task record (trimmed and scrubbed). The key's plan is not charged the 1-credit base, so x-elfa-credits reads 0 on the 1-credit v2 endpoints (the zero claim is pruned and the published card settles) and 4 on the 5-credit v2 endpoints (the claim settles, the card rides out as mismatch.derived). v3 reports its list price and x-elfa-credits-detail.

arcs.name: Hormuz shipping risk
arcs.summary: Reports describe continuing tanker attacks near Hormuz, including two attacks near Khasab, while South Korea plans a non-combat mission to protect commercial shipping. Iran says Qatari mediation shortened a proposed reopening timeline, and U.S. forces are enforcing a blockade.

arcs.name: Anthropic IPO offering and debut
arcs.summary: Anthropic’s shares began trading on Nasdaq after the IPO priced at $83, and the offering raised $93.5 billion after the greenshoe exercise. Shares closed their first day above the offer price, while UK retail demand was reported to exceed 100,000 investors.
